title: Validation Center data_sync_autonomy_backend plan can fail when runtime catalog lacks matching allowlist entry
description:
Expected: Validation Center should only expose runnable plans whose command_key exists in the runtime backend allowlist, and the data_sync_autonomy_backend plan added by this feature must load without a non-allowlisted command_key error after deployment.
Actual: Validation Center page shows: Validation Center Error: Validation plan data_sync_autonomy_backend uses non-allowlisted command_key='nox_data_sync_autonomy_backend'. The plan was introduced by the data-sync autonomy feature, so a mixed deployment or missing runtime allowlist blocks the Validation Center page.
reproduce_command: Open Validation Center against a runtime checkout that includes tests/aistock_validation/catalog/test_plans.yaml plan_key=data_sync_autonomy_backend but whose loaded backend/services/validation/plan_catalog.py lacks ALLOWED_COMMAND_KEYS['nox_data_sync_autonomy_backend']; or start the validation API and request /api/v1/validation/plans.
closure_requirements: Default ValidationPlanCatalog loads data_sync_autonomy_backend without non-allowlisted command_key errors.
ValidationExecutionRunner only executes the allowlisted nox session for data_sync_autonomy_backend and never arbitrary shell.
Independent worktree validation loads configured .env and uses TDX_DB_DEV_* for read-only dev DB smoke; offline fallback is only a CI/fresh-host fallback.
GitHub issue #93 receives the fix commit and validation evidence before Main merge review.

events.note: Related to current feature branch feature/data-sync-autonomy-20260519-impl. The branch already contains the allowlist mapping, but the observed page error is directly related to the newly introduced data_sync_autonomy_backend plan and must be tracked before Main review.
Fix should preserve the Validation Center no-arbitrary-shell contract: never run command_key values not present in backend ALLOWED_COMMAND_KEYS.
Fixing in the existing data-sync autonomy feature worktree because the issue is directly introduced by the new plan/allowlist slice.
Fixed by commit 88451e0: default catalog regression, controlled runner regression, env/dev-DB smoke loading, nox coverage, dev DB schema verification, and merge-tree preview all passed.
Merged into local main with merge commit 47090dd and reran data_sync_autonomy_backend/local_data_management_audit successfully before pushing GitHub main.
